description: This file contains Android UI tests for benchmarking app startup performance and scroll frame timing using the Benchmark library. It defines the StartupMacrobenchmark class with test methods for measuring cold startup and scroll frame metrics.

classes.name: StartupMacrobenchmark
classes.description: AndroidJUnit4 test class for benchmarking app startup and UI performance metrics

methods.name: coldStartup
methods.description: Test method to measure cold startup time of the app using StartupTimingMetric

methods.name: startupAndScrollFrameTiming
methods.description: Test method to measure frame timing during startup and UI scrolling

methods.name: runBenchmarkOrSkip
methods.description: Utility method to run a benchmark block or skip if device issues are detected
